heading: Application
lead: This chapter applies to a vessel of the United States except a fishing or whaling vessel or a yacht.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes Revised sectionSource section (U.S. Code) 1090146:65346:65446:65546:65646:658 Section 10901 provides that chapter 109 applies to all vessels of the United States except fishing vessels, whaling vessels or yachts.
